//: Build output and dependencies are never hand-edited, and watching them is what makes this repository slow to work in. Measured 2026-07-30: 88 worktrees, 86 carrying target/, 61 carrying node_modules, one sampled target/ holding 82,891 entries - roughly seven million watched files, with 7.0 GB of 55.6 GB free and 39 VS Code processes holding 17.1 GB. Every cargo build rewrites thousands of files inside a watched tree, and every window whose workspace contains it is notified. files.exclude is deliberately not set: it hides entries from the explorer rather than reducing work.
